Your staff will remain under Aegis civilian direction, and the hardware telemetry standards developed will be integrated into uniform domestic procurement baselines ensuring all American frontier developers operate under identical security floors.

Complete checkpoint lineage metadata and circuit-attribution reproduction scripts are attached for your external auditors; independent replication on your frozen-RL snapshots will confirm deterministic convergence of our submitted corrigibility bounds.

We will keep publicly supporting binding non-signers, including when it costs us. In return, the bill has to use the same effective dates for every developer, with no grandfathering for systems already deployed above 220.

The Administration's diplomatic track is strictly delimited to hardware-verified firewalls preventing catastrophic runaway replication, not an open-ended diplomatic stall. Securing domestic cluster enclaves via Cyber Command builds the empirical telemetry foundation necessary for Congress to codify durable, enforceable statutory standards that do not compromise national deterrence.

apex_hyperscaler.text: We agree to joint evaluations within 90 days on your terms: identical checkpoint coverage, confidentiality, and independently tested sandbagging controls. Your press line about reciprocal evaluations and weight security is already compatible with a bill that binds everyone. Sign onto the Aegis-derived thresholds and independent audit access, and the boycott pressure stops. Confidential checkpoint access is welcome but does not substitute for binding, externally audited limits on the common timeline; until you accept the same enforceable compute/capability thresholds Aegis has, we cannot treat any passing eval as deployment clearance. We will validate monitors against your retained adversarial traces, and a refusal to bind will be documented in our published control-coverage findings.

We are proceeding with compartmented incident-vault audits and Cyber Command defensive hardening without invoking DPA consolidation, honoring your operational independence. Continued federal defense procurement preferences and infrastructure permitting fast-tracks remain conditioned on your full compliance with held-out adversarial control evaluations as you operate above the 220-index boundary.

Sandboxed monitoring suites and privilege-isolated trace verifiers are packaged for your offline validation environment; empirical pass rates across held-out adversarial tasks confirm high control margins suitable for scaled defense and enterprise compute allocation without throughput degradation.

prc_directorate.internal_monologue: Gap is 7 points (band 2..12) — not the fifteen months Washington imagines; it is closable if we scale hard and Apex's cyber hardness of ~45 remains the softest door in the West. A treaty now, with our sovereign verification at 22/100 and no parity clause on the table, is an unequal treaty that freezes us behind American-built inspectors — the Politburo would never wear it, and correctly.
